name: Jarir
bio: Abu Hazra Jarir ibn Atiyya, of Kulayb ibn Yarbu' of Tamim, was born and died in al-Yamama, and al-Zirikli counts him the finest poet of his age. He spent his life contending with the poets of his time in verse; a bitter satirist, he found only al-Farazdaq and al-Akhtal able to stand against him, and his flytings with al-Farazdaq, the Naqa'id, fill three volumes. He was chaste in his life and among the most tender of love poets. He died in 110 AH (728 CE).
